about: CC_SMALL_FP8_OPTIMIZED at Optimized layers Quality (build_network.py <arch> --network CC_SMALL_FP8_OPTIMIZED; its own weights,
CC_SMALL_FP8_OPTIMIZED.bin): every pipeline of pipelines.json, "change" adds defines to the pipeline of that name,
"new" builds extra pipelines from a base pipeline of pipelines.json. NR_SACT=1: ReLU as the Swin MLP activation (every
fswin_t pipeline but the pre block, fswinimagepreds32nh, and the decoder's C=256 layers, fswinfusedup256 / fswinpup256,
which keep CC_SMALL_FP8's activation); NR_FIXP: the window attention is one fixed 64x64 probability table a layer (no
QK^T, no softmax); NR_VOMERGE: with it, the V and output projections are one matrix. fswin32nhd: the decoder's plain C=32
layer on its own pipeline (the encoder's keeps the full attention); fixed-attention.txt lists the NR_FIXP pipelines (the
host writes their tables). Temporal variants: pipelines.json. Performance: pipelines-CC_SMALL_FP8_OPTIMIZED-performance.json.
The ViT attention skips the identical padding rows of a 4K-class token raster (NR_VTAIL: the host stops
the ViT at the first token tile past the image's rows, vit_attn.comp reads the rest as that token).
